steps.notes: Today: WildFly itself doesn't boot (WP8.10 baseline). Once WP8.10 lands, expect first-failure to migrate into the deployment scan — see expected_stderr_contains.

acceptance_when_passing.notes: Flip to this block once the EJBCA EAR deploys cleanly. Keep the original baseline in `history[]` for regression tracking.

known_blockers.summary: WildFly itself does not boot under rust-jvm yet.
java.lang.invoke complete — Hibernate proxies + Weld CDI exercise corners not yet probed.
Dynamic Proxy.newProxyInstance — partial today; Hibernate/RESTEasy proxies will exercise this.
Cipher full algo set (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305) — TLS + token encryption.
Signature/KeyFactory/KeyGenerator (ECDSA, Ed25519, RSA-PSS) — every issued cert.
BouncyCastle compatibility — partial. EJBCA's deepest crypto consumer.
ASN.1 DER for X.509 / PKCS#10 / PKCS#12.
SSLEngine TLS 1.3 — partial; client-cert renegotiation for admin mTLS still gaps.
FileChannel.map STUB → H2 MV-store cannot open. Likely first-failure once WP8.10 unblocks.

update_policy: Update this file any time a triaged WP lands that changes expected_final_rc, the expected_stderr_contains alternatives list, or the known_blockers array. When the EAR finally deploys, swap the top-level expected_* with the acceptance_when_passing block and move the old block into history[].
